citations.assessment: The Mishnah uses the designation without a name roster. Sanhedrin supplies the personal names separately.
The catalogue names the four and reports Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak’s list of five. The local count of the three Shimons is supported by the nearby naming of Shimon the Timnite.
The debaters have two members; the separate student list includes Chananya ben Chakhinai and Rabbi Elazar ben Matya.
